metadata.title: Robinhood Co-Founder Baiju Bhatt Breaks Down the Lucky Streaks in His Career - WSJ

content.text:
Does it take luck or skill to spark a viral meme?
Baiju Bhatt, the billionaire behind Robinhood HOOD 5.58%increase; up pointing triangle and, now, Cowboy Space Corp., weighed in on whether skill or good fortune is behind everything from pivoting a business model (something he’s done a few times) to creating a viral meme. The meme? All skill, he told me in the latest episode of The WSJ Money Interview.
